_comentario: Noises to imitate WITH YOUR MOUTH ONLY: no clapping, no banging the table, no props. If hands are allowed the game stops being fun.

cartas.texto: Imitate a motorbike that won't start.
Imitate a microwave finishing.
Imitate a door creaking open very slowly.
Imitate a balloon deflating.
Imitate a hen that has seen something odd.
Imitate someone slurping very hot soup.
Imitate a car's reversing beep.
Imitate an old rotary telephone.
Imitate rain on a metal roof.
Imitate an ambulance siren driving away.
Imitate a mosquito closing in on your ear.
Imitate a zip going up and down.
Imitate a train going through a tunnel.
Imitate someone snoring in three different stages.
Imitate a fizzy drink can opening.
Imitate a lawnmower starting up.
Imitate an alarm clock you don't want to hear.
Imitate a cow that is very far away.
Imitate footsteps on snow.
Imitate an old fax machine.
Imitate a mop being wrung out.
Imitate a very hungry stomach.
Imitate a jammed printer.
Imitate a cat that wants to come into a room.
Imitate a lift arriving at its floor.
Imitate a jet ski at full speed.
Imitate a glass breaking, without breaking anything.
Imitate a smoke alarm with a low battery.
Imitate wind whistling through a window frame.
Imitate a duck that has lost its voice.
Imitate a blender making a very thick smoothie.
Imitate three different animals without repeating a sound, clearly enough to tell apart.
